claims.evidence: No photo evidence of usage history, receipts, or wear patterns provided; single front image only.
No scale reference (tape measure, known-size object) in the photo to confirm dimensions.

risks.risk: Fabric condition hidden (stains, tears, odors, discoloration)
risks.proof: Close-up shots of seat, armrests, back, and underside in bright light; a video pan of the whole piece

risks.risk: Frame and cushion structural integrity unknown
risks.proof: Video of someone sitting on it and a shot of the underside/frame joints

risks.risk: Pet or smoke exposure not visible in photos
risks.proof: Seller statement plus close-up of fabric fibers and a video walk-through of the room
Photo with tape measure or known-size object next to the sofa
risks.if_unproven: priced at minimum plausible size for a 2-seater

risks.proof: Additional photos from rear and bottom angles

risks.risk: Material composition unclear (genuine vs synthetic upholstery)
risks.proof: Close-up macro shot of fabric texture and a tag/label photo if present

proof_requests: Full video walk-around of the sofa including back and underside
Close-up photos of any stains, tears, or wear marks
Photo with a tape measure or ruler against the sofa for true dimensions
Close-up of fabric texture or any material/brand label
Short video of someone sitting on it to check firmness and frame stability
response.reason: The item type is clearly identified as a 2-seater sofa, but condition, material, and size claims are all unverifiable from the single photo, so it must be priced at worst-case condition pending further proof.
